 On the night of 3–4 November, the TV schedule will change to cover the results of the US elections
 03 November 2026 
 Updated at 18:12 
 2 min read 
 To mark the US midterm elections, the television schedule for the evening of 3 November, the night of 3 November and the morning of 4 November will be adjusted to broadcast the results live and provide commentary. Starting with Repubblica’s special programme.
 Midterm Live on *Repubblica*
 ‘Midterm Live’ is the name of the special video programme that will provide results, analysis and commentary in real time on the Repubblica website from 6 am to 9 am on 4 November. Repubblica will follow the vote count for the mid-term elections alongside correspondents and reporters from the United States – Paolo Mastrolilli and Anna Lombardi – and from European capitals – Claudio Tito, Anais Ginori and Enrico Franceschini. Featuring the newspaper’s regular contributors, from Paolo Garimberti to Gabriele Romagnoli and Gianni Riotta , and from Francesca Caferri and Gabriella Colarusso to Fabio Tonacci . Also appearing will be Lucio Caracciolo, editor of Limes ; Lucia Annunziata ; former ambassador Piero Benassi ; and political scientist and writer Arianna Farinelli . Closing the programme: Stefano Massini , currently performing at the Piccolo Theatre in Milan in *Lo Zar* , and the programme’s director, Stefano Cappellini . In the studio: Laura Pertici and Francesco Fasiolo with Marco Contini, Annalisa Cuzzocrea, Alberto Flores D’Arcais, Massimo Giannini and Laura Lucchini. 
 Elezioni di midterm Usa - La guida/1: Cosa sono e perché ne parliamo
 Rai’s programme schedule
 On Rai (state broadcaster) 1, coverage begins at 11.45 pm on 3 November and runs until 4.00 am with a special programme by Bruno Vespa , in collaboration with Tg1 (Rai's flagship evening news), featuring a ‘Porta a Porta Speciale Midterm 2026’ , with guests, live links, in-depth reports and analysis of the vote. On the same channel, from 4.50 am, coverage switches to RaiNews24 , which will also be broadcasting live non-stop on its all-news channel with real-time results. At 7.10am further news will be featured in the Tg1 Special. Also on Wednesday 4 November, on Rai 2, Tg2 will dedicate two special editions to the mid-term elections, at 10.00am and 6.00pm, in addition to Tg2 Post at 9.00pm. On Rai3, Tg3 Linea Notte will be broadcast from midnight, and Tg3 will air two special editions at 12.25 and 16.15. Naturally, there will also be extensive coverage of the US elections in all the usual news bulletins.

 30 October 2026 
 The Mentana marathon
 On La7 at around half past midnight, following Giovanni Floris ’s ‘diMartedì’ , the election special with Enrico Mentana begins. The editor-in-chief will follow the day’s uncertainties with his ‘Maratona Mentana ’. Over the course of seven hours of live coverage, ‘Maratona Mentana’ will track the progress of the vote, the first results and political reactions, featuring live reports, analysis and contributions from journalists, experts and studio guests.
 The midterms in 15 minutes: Repubblica’s video series 
 28 October 2026 
 Mediaset
 Mediaset will broadcast dedicated coverage on Retequattro and Canale 5. On the night of 3–4 November, Retequattro will air *Verità Nascoste* with Milo Infante , featuring the first election results from 9.30 pm, before handing over to the *Speciale Quarta Repubblica – Midterm* with Nicola Porro , running until 6.00 am. In-depth coverage of the election will continue on the morning of Wednesday 4 November on Canale 5 from 6.00 am to 8.00 am with *Speciale Tg5 – Midterm: Which America? *, presented by Cesara Buonamici. The US election will also be featured in prime time on Retequattro with *È sempre Cartabianca*, presented by Bianca Berlinguer .
 Sky TG 24
 From 10.30 pm on Tuesday, Sky Tg24 will be covering the US mid-term elections with ‘Midterm 2026 : America at the Polls ’, a special programme presented by Liliana Faccioli Pintozzi and Marco Congiu , featuring live reports from the United States, analysis and updates on the results throughout the night and the following day. On the ground, Sky Tg24 will follow the various stages of the vote with Federico Leoni in Washington DC, Cristiana Mancini in Texas and Iacopo Luzi in Michigan, to report on local dynamics and gather reactions and accounts from key battlegrounds. A central focus will be on data analysis: the Sky Cube will be transformed into a data room, where Roberto Palladino and Alberto Giuffrè will present exit polls, results and in-depth analysis to track the progress of the vote in real time. The coverage will also benefit from the collaboration of YouTrend and Lorenzo Pregliasco , who will provide analytical tools and insights into the results.
